cohort: All deliveries in Finland between 2004 and 2017 (n = 800,484)
finding: The incidence of shoulder dystocia in Finland increased significantly from 0.10% to 0.32% between 2004 and 2017, with instrumental vaginal delivery, maternal diabetes, BMI ≥25, age ≥40 years, and gestational age ≥41 weeks identified as significant risk factors.
mod_finding: Instrumental vaginal delivery was associated with a higher risk of shoulder dystocia compared with spontaneous deliveries.
